crossRefs.note: “ ‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.
Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect…
Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;
Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject…
With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much elder than your father.

people.name: Barachel
people.line: The father of Elihu, one of Job's friends.

people.name: Elihu
people.line: A young man who spoke to Job.

translations.web: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old; Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.
translations.bsb: So Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite declared: “I am young in years, while you are old; that is why I was timid and afraid to tell you what I know.
translations.kjv: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.
translations.asv: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; Wherefore I held back, and durst not show you mine opinion.
